test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

Our children need __vital__ lessons in wealth management.
solution:
The **correct answer** is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'superfluous'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "vital"** means essential or crucial (जीवनीय).

 
 
• **Example: **Learning about budgeting and saving is vital for financial literacy.
 
 
 
• **Superfluous **means unnecessary or more than enough (अतिरिक्त).
 
 
• **Example:** Teaching advanced investment strategies might be superfluous for young children who are just learning the basics of money management.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is - '**Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Healthy **means in good physical or mental condition (स्वस्थ).
 
• **Organic** means relating to or derived from living matter (जैविक).
 
• **Clever** means quick to understand, learn, and devise or apply ideas (चतुर).
